findings.title: TabRecord list is allocated on every GUI event in DoWindowContents
findings.detail: Source/TitanSettings.cs:71-76 builds a new List<TabRecord> with three closures on every OnGUI pass. That is harmless in a settings window. Vanilla keeps its tab list in a field (MainTabWindow_History passes a stored `tabs` to TabDrawer.DrawTabs) and uses the Func<bool> constructor so the selected tab is read live. If you want the vanilla shape, cache the list in a static field built with the Func<bool> overload. This is optional.

findings.title: Selected settings tab persists for the session through a static field
findings.detail: `private static Tab tab` (Source/TitanSettings.cs:65) keeps the last-open tab across openings of the window and resets to Lights on restart. This is the usual pattern and is not saved, so no Scribe change is needed. It is mentioned so the behaviour is intended rather than accidental.
